meta.applies_to: Trianglz - Web Design System and every new Web DS built from Web_Design_System_Skill

focus.style: focus-ring (inputs: inset 2px color/border/focus) / focus-ring-offset (buttons: 2px gap + 4px ring)

spacing.rule: every padding and gap bound to space/*; no raw values

components.naming: Family / Variant, Title Case properties and values
components.dark_mode: switch the Semantic mode on the frame; never duplicate components
components.bound: fills, strokes, padding, gap, radius, text styles, effect styles: 100% bound, 0 remote

recolor.principle: A color change edits only Primitive values. Semantic tokens alias Primitives, and components use Semantic tokens, so they follow automatically.

generation.curve: each ramp keeps its captured lightness (L) per step and its chroma ratio to the base; hue moves to the new color; the base step becomes the exact new color and the lightness difference fades out toward both ends; chroma is reduced to fit sRGB

steps: Identify the ramp(s) to change in tokens.json > ramps (brand is usually blue; check which Semantic tokens alias it).
Run: python tools/recolor.py Reference_Library/Trianglz/Web --ramp <ramp> --base <#hex>  (writes data/recolor/<date>-<ramp>.json and a Figma script).
Review the contrast report; if a pair fails, pick a darker/lighter step in the Semantic alias (never a raw hex).
Apply the script with figma_execute: it sets the new values into the SAME Primitive variables by name (names never change).
Re-run: python tools/build_tokens.py Reference_Library/Trianglz/Web after re-exporting variables (or python tools/recolor.py ... --write-tokens) so tokens.json matches Figma.
Screenshot ➜ Colors and every component page in Light and Dark; compare against the previous screenshots.
never: rename or delete Primitive variables during a recolor
put raw hex in Semantic tokens
edit a single step by hand without regenerating the ramp

contrast_fix.why: text and border tokens move first; backgrounds keep the layout look

manual: Component fixes are in Component_Skills/*/references/gaps.md (Button has no Pressed/Loading state or label/icon properties; Tabs, Badge and Alert lack text properties; generic Label2/Hint2 properties).
Page names: remove trailing/double spaces and fix "➜ Paganation & Tabs".

off_limits.note: Single list of prohibitions. ds-auditor reports each id with a count; hooks enforce the ones marked hook:.

rules.rule: Do not create component-specific tokens (e.g. color/btn/*, button-padding) unless the user asks. Components use Semantic tokens.
rules.check: variable names in Semantic collections must not start with a component name (btn, button, input, card, chip, tab, badge...)
rules.exception: the user explicitly asks for a component token layer
rules.known_violations: color/btn/* (Trianglz Web) exists; keep it in the template but do not add more

rules.rule: No raw hex outside Primitives and no raw px/pt/dp for padding, gap, radius or font values in components and screens.
rules.check: 0 unbound fills/strokes/padding/gap/radius/text values; tokens.json > recolor_readiness.ready = true

rules.rule: Never edit the original Trianglz template files. Duplicate them and work in the copy.
rules.check: no write operation targets an original file key
rules.exception: the user explicitly asks for a change in the original (e.g. deleting a leftover page)

rules.rule: Never detach an instance. Use instance swaps, slots and exposed properties; if a needed swap is missing, fix the component.
rules.check: 0 detached instances; no detachInstance() in scripts

rules.rule: No default layer or property names: Frame 12, Group 5, Rectangle 3, Vector, Property 1, Variant5, Component 1, trailing ' 2' copies.
rules.check: 0 layers or properties matching the default-name patterns

rules.rule: Foundation documentation pages (colors, typography, spacing, radius, shadows, grid, icons) live only in the ⭐Setup group; component docs sit on their own ➜ page inside their ⭐ group.
rules.check: no foundation doc frame outside ⭐Setup pages

rules.rule: No remote (library) variables, styles or components inside the DS file.
No Mode=Light|Dark variants and no duplicated dark component sets; dark is the Semantic mode on the frame.
rules.check: 0 variant properties named Mode with Light/Dark values

rules.rule: Icons are Icon/* instances (Lucide style) with swap properties; no drawn vectors, text glyphs or empty placeholders.
rules.check: every icon is an instance of the local icon set

rules.rule: Color lives in variables only; no color (paint) styles.
A recolor changes Primitive values only; never rename, delete or recreate Primitives during a recolor.
Never install tools, packages, MCP servers or plugins on the user's behalf; show the steps and let the user do it.
Never push, create a remote repository or publish a Figma library without the user's explicit request.
No absolute machine paths in skills, briefs, data or memory; paths are relative to the Root.
